messages:
Maya Lin: Heads-up  TechDaily published a roundup that interprets our chart as a "50% cost reduction" claim. That exact number isn't in our post. Link: https://techdaily.example/article-id
Omar Lewis: Saw that. They pulled a number from a chart legend and framed it as a topline stat. Do we ask for a correction?
Priya Rao: First step: pull the screenshot and the quote. Jordan, can support surface any inbound customer questions?
Jordan (support): On it. I'll flag any inbound tickets mentioning TechDaily and capture screenshots.
LegalBot: Legal review recommended: request a factual correction and supply our clarified language. Avoid accusatory phrasing.
Maya Lin: Draft correction to propose to the reporter: "Correction request: Our published benchmark report does not make a blanket 50% claim. The chart compared two configuration baselines; see methodology section for context: https://redwood.example/bench/methods."
Omar Lewis: I can DM the reporter and ask for a small correction. Use neutral tone and offer the methodology link.
Priya Rao: Also prepare a public clarifying line we can post to socials and send to partners if needed. Suggested short line: "Clarification: benchmark charts compare specific configuration baselines; full methodology is linked in the report."
Maya Lin: Good. Please QA the blog methodology paragraph; I'll add one sentence explicitly calling out that chart interpretation depends on workload mix.
Omar Lewis: I'll update the FAQ on the blog: add bullet "How should the charts be read?" with one short para. Will push a minor edit and note it in the changelog.
Priya Rao: Social ops: hold reactive tweet until reporter acknowledges correction. If they decline, we post the clarifying line and pin it to the blog post. Agree?
Omar Lewis: Agreed. press-bot  pause any queued amplification until we decide.
press-bot: Action: paused queued posts tagged [benchmarks]. Status=paused.
Jordan (support): First inbound mentions rolling in. Two customers asked if the 50% was their expected improvement. Marking as "awaiting comms" and directing to internal FAQ for now.
Maya Lin: Great. Jordan, send a short internal note to sales/support: one-liner clarification + link to updated FAQ. I'll draft and post in #all-hands if needed.
Priya Rao: Also FYI an editor at TradeWeekly requested a CEO interview for next week to discuss methodology. We need to confirm availability and talking points. Maya, are you ok to coordinate?
Maya Lin: Yes. Tentative availability Tue 11:00 PT. I'll confirm with the CEO. We should prepare two talking points: 1) methodology transparency 2) how customers see value in production. Keep numbers out of the teaser.
Omar Lewis: I'll prep a 2-minute CEO brief and a short Q&A doc for the interview. Legal, please review the Q&A for any risky phrasing.
LegalBot: Will review Q&A and flag any absolute comparisons or customer-identifying details. Provide turnaround ETA: 3 hours.
Maya Lin: OK timeline: Omar to DM TechDaily reporter now with correction request. If they accept, we unpause social and update blog quietly. If they decline, publish our clarification and escalate to exec-comm before any broader push. Finalize CEO interview logistics after reporter outcome.
press-bot: Reminder set: check reporter reply in 30 minutes. Notification posted to this thread when reply received.
Omar Lewis: DM sent. Copy of message posted here for record: `Hi — thanks for the coverage. Quick note: our benchmark report does not make a blanket "50%" claim. Could you update the phrasing to reference the specific chart and link to our methodology? Happy to provide a short clarifying sentence.`
Maya Lin: Thanks Omar. Team standby for the reporter response. Jordan, keep logging inbound customer notes. Priya, hold social copy until we confirm.
Jordan (support): Will update the ticket queue and ping this thread on any hot leads.
Maya Lin: If reporter corrects, we tweet the clarifying line and resume scheduled amplification. If not, we post clarifying line and follow up with an internal exec note. We'll reconvene in 45 minutes to decide next steps.
